name: KOL Engagement Companies

pain_points: Proving to sponsors that KOL programmes created engagement and movement, not just attendance
buying_signals: Sponsor pressure for outcomes beyond attendance

fit_logic.proceed: They want to shift from access-only to proof-led sponsor value
fit_logic.stop: We sell access, outcomes don't matter

what_they_sell: KOL access + credible content + audience pull
what_proof_means: Proof to sponsors that the KOL programme created engagement and movement, not just attendance. Proof for which formats/KOL topics actually land.
yoke_strengths: Workflow and governance for KOL content
Trendlines across a KOL series, not one event
yoke_weaknesses: If their value prop is only 'access' and they do not care about outcomes

messaging.value_proposition: Yoke helps KOL engagement companies shift from access-only to proof-led value—showing sponsors which KOL formats and topics drive real engagement.
key_benefits: Manage KOL content workflow with governance and approvals
Prove KOL programme impact beyond attendance
messaging.elevator_pitch: KOL companies sell access but sponsors want proof of impact. Yoke shows which KOL formats work and keeps engagement alive between events—justifying higher sponsor packages.

disqualify_filters: Access-only model with no outcomes focus

two_lever_framing.lever_a: Increase sponsor value with proof-led KOL programmes
two_lever_framing.lever_b: Reduce KOL workflow complexity and approval friction
